# `keytool -help`: the commands; `keytool -COMMAND -help`: the option lines of each command (Temurin 21.0.13).
commands: -certreq -changealias -delete -exportcert -genkeypair -genseckey -gencert -importcert -importpass -importkeystore -keypasswd -list -printcert -printcertreq -printcrl -storepasswd -showinfo -version
